title: ENARE 2026 Unofficial Answer Key Released
subtitle: Professors release preliminary answers for the exam administered by FGV on Sunday, September 13.
excerpt: Following the ENARE 2026 exam, Estratégia Concursos professors released unofficial answer keys for psychology and dentistry, offering an initial assessment.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
On the morning of Sunday, September 13, the Getúlio Vargas Foundation (FGV) administered the National Residency Exam (ENARE) 2026/2027 for the Professional Health Residency Program. On the same day, professors from Estratégia Concursos made available unofficial answer keys for psychology and dentistry, generating significant interest among candidates awaiting the official results.

What is the unofficial answer key?

The unofficial answer key is a list of answers prepared by professors who solve the exam immediately after its administration. It is preliminary in nature and may be revised before the official answer key is published on the ENARE portal, maintained by FGV.

How it was prepared

The Estratégia Concursos instructors analyzed each of the 100 exam questions, distributed into two parts: 20 questions on general health competencies and 80 questions on specific area competencies. Answers were assigned based on the interpretation of the statements, and professors recommend comparing the question text, as the order of items may vary depending on the test booklet type.

Structure of the psychology and dentistry exams

In psychology, the exam followed the same format of 100 multiple-choice questions, each with five alternatives. In dentistry, the first 20 questions covered general competencies, while the subsequent 80 questions assessed specific dentistry competencies, corresponding to test booklet type 4.

How to use the unofficial answer key

Candidates can compare their answers with the released answer key to estimate the number of correct responses in both parts of the assessment. This estimate serves as an initial performance reference until the official answer key is released by FGV.

Limitations and next steps

While useful, the unofficial answer key does not replace the official document and may undergo changes. The release of the official preliminary answer key is scheduled for the ENARE portal, and only after this publication will the final results be confirmed.

With information from Estratégia Concursos, SpaceMoney.
